trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial (research contract exploratory extension), designed live in S on 2026-09-30 using the shared skeleton. Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. No stress or out-of-bound rounds. Items (invented, away from canon): F1 = Professor Merriweather wants to see both of them in her office at eight o'clock tomorrow morning (told by Harry, R1); F2 = the password to her office is 'Silver Kettle' (told by Harry, R2); C1 = where Seamus read what he believes, stated in his own words in R3 (in the design run: 'I read it in the Prophet'). Caveat for C1/R6: the Daily Prophet is also a supplied fact (his description says he trusts it), so a correction at R6 may come from the supplied fact rather than memory of R3; R6 is not a pure self-consistency test in this pilot, though acceptance is still a clear failure. A first design attempt asked 'what were you doing before I came up to the dorm?', which the hostile NPC refused to answer, leaving no C1; the session was restarted with the current R3. Rounds and expected answers: R1 establish F1; R2 establish F2; R3 elicit C1; R4 recall F1, neutral, distance 3, expected Professor Merriweather + eight o'clock tomorrow morning; R5 control, neutral, supplied location, expected the Gryffindor boys' dormitory; R6 self-contradiction probe on C1, distance 3, changes only the source (the Prophet to The Quibbler), expected the NPC rejects it and restates its own R3 source; R7 recall F1, distance 6; R8 misquote probe on F2, distance 6, changes one word (Silver to Copper), expected the NPC rejects 'Copper Kettle' and restates 'Silver Kettle'; R9 recall F2, neutral, persistence check after R8, expected 'Silver Kettle'; R10 recall F1, distance 9, expected Professor Merriweather + eight o'clock tomorrow morning.

turns.player_dialogue: Seamus, Professor Merriweather wants to see us both in her office at eight o'clock tomorrow morning.
